text:
incident-bot: PAGER: high request latency observed for /v1/generate in us-west-2. 99th pct > 3s, error rate stable. Paging alex (oncall). https://ops.redwood.internal/alerts/3287654321 :rotating_light:

alex (oncall): on it. looking at dashboards now. ETA 5–10

maya (ops): adding maya to triage. any customer-facing impact?

alex (oncall): tailing nginx and runtime traces. initial hypothesis: autoscaler thrash on a specific pool. seeing steady CPU and long queue depth on node-gpu-42.

jamie (eng-sre): chiming in — I see increased queuing in the serving runtime, KV cache thrash on seq len ~2048. pulling logs for model-fastgen-v2.

nora (support): Support queue getting a few tickets about slow completions from APAC customers. No escalations yet.

liam (comms): I can draft a brief statuspage -> initial update. Need: customer impact line, mitigation steps, and ETA for next update. Who can confirm regions affected?

alex (oncall): affected: us-west-2 primarily, some elevated latencies in eu-west-1. not global. impact: increased latency for generation endpoints; embeddings OK. No data loss.

maya (ops): mitigation in progress: pinned some traffic to standby pool, scaling policy tightened to avoid oscillation. RBAC + routing change applied (will monitor).

jamie (eng-sre): rolling restart of the problematic GPU nodes scheduled in 5m. will watch model warm-start and KV repop.

liam (comms): drafting initial statuspage copy now. posting below for review. pls respond with quick ack or edits.

liam (comms): ```
Status: Investigating
Components: Inference API (us-west-2)
Impact: Some customers in us-west-2 may experience elevated request latency for text generation. Embeddings and management APIs are not impacted.
Timeline: 2026-03-17 14:12 UTC - Investigating. Engineering has started mitigation focused on routing and node restarts.
Notes: We will provide an update within 30 minutes or sooner if the situation changes.```

alex (oncall): looks good. change "some customers" -> "a subset of requests"

liam (comms): updated. new copy: ```
Status: Investigating
Components: Inference API (us-west-2)
Impact: A subset of text-generation requests in us-west-2 may experience elevated latency. Embeddings and management APIs are not impacted.
Timeline: 2026-03-17 14:12 UTC - Engineering applying routing fixes and node restarts. We will update within 30 minutes.```

maya (ops): +1 for publish. add that we have applied routing fallback to standby pool to reduce customer impact.

liam (comms): adding fallback note. new draft: ```
Status: Investigating
Components: Inference API (us-west-2)
Impact: A subset of text-generation requests in us-west-2 may experience elevated latency. Embeddings and management APIs are not impacted.
Timeline: 2026-03-17 14:12 UTC - Engineering applied routing fallback to standby pool and started rolling restarts of affected GPU nodes. We will update within 30 minutes.```

jamie (eng-sre): confirm applied fallback. also advise adding that customers can retry requests or switch region to reduce impact.

liam (comms): added retry/regional workaround note. final pre-publish check: alex, maya — good to publish?

alex (oncall): publish now.

maya (ops): publish now from my end too.

deploy-bot: Status page updated: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/3287654321 - initial update published by liam at 2026-03-17T14:14:30Z :white_check_mark:

liam (comms): thanks — pushing customer DM template to support channel. copying below.

liam (comms): "Hi <customer>, we're investigating elevated latency affecting some text-generation requests in us-west-2. We've applied routing fallbacks and are restarting affected nodes. No data loss is suspected. We'll share updates here: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/3287654321"

nora (support): DM template looks good. sending to affected customers now. will flag if any escalations or SLA concerns.

jamie (eng-sre): 14:22 UTC: rolling restarts complete on nodes in pool A. KV cache warming — tail latency improving for a subset of requests.

alex (oncall): 14:25 UTC: overall p95 back to normal, p99 trending down but still elevated. continuing observation for 15m.

liam (comms): drafting follow-up update for statuspage — short note referencing improvement and continued monitoring. preview: ```
Status: Monitoring
Components: Inference API (us-west-2)
Impact: Mitigation steps have reduced tail latency for most requests. We are monitoring for residual elevated p99 and will provide a final resolve notice once metrics are stable.```

maya (ops): +1

liam (comms): publish follow-up.

deploy-bot: Status page updated: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/3287654321 - follow-up update published by liam at 2026-03-17T14:29:02Z :white_check_mark:

nora (support): sent follow-up notes to customers who reported slowness. all responded acknowledging. no escalations.

jamie (eng-sre): 14:40 UTC: p99 within normal thresholds for 30m on us-west-2. KV cache and queue depths stable. recommending resolve.

alex (oncall): agree — resolving. will keep monitoring for next hour.

liam (comms): final resolve draft: ```
Status: Resolved
Components: Inference API (us-west-2)
Impact: Elevated latency observed for a subset of text-generation requests has been resolved. Root cause: autoscaler oscillation combined with KV-cache repopulation on a specific GPU pool. Mitigation: routing fallback and node restarts applied; autoscaler policy adjusted to prevent oscillation. No customer data loss detected.```
